title: Spiced Apple Buttermilk Muffins
changes_from_base: A creamed butter batter with buttermilk, cinnamon and nutmeg, studded with diced tart apple and topped with cinnamon sugar.
summary: Soft buttermilk muffins with chunks of tart apple, cinnamon, nutmeg and a cinnamon sugar crust.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
tart green apples (such as Granny Smith), peeled, cored and diced

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line the tin with cases.

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: Whisk the flour, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, bicarbonate of soda and baking powder in a bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Beat the soft butter with the caster sugar for about 3 min until pale and fluffy. Beat in the eggs one by one, then the vanilla.

steps.title: Alternate
steps.text: Beat in half the flour mix on low, then half the buttermilk, then the rest of each; stop as soon as the batter looks smooth.

steps.title: Apples
steps.text: Fold in the diced apple and spoon the batter into the cases until two-thirds full. Stir the topping sugar with its cinnamon and sprinkle a little over each.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 24-27 min, until golden and a skewer in the centre comes out clean.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool 5 min in the tin, then on the rack.

tips: The most common mistake is cutting the apple too big; keep the pieces to about 1 cm so the muffins hold together.
Tart green apples keep their shape and balance the sugar.
Have the butter and eggs at room temperature so the batter does not split.
storage: Keep in an airtight box for up to 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
